UPDATE yunzhanghu_unsign_reconciliations
        SET lease_owner = NULL,
            lease_expires_at = NULL,
            last_remote_status = COALESCE($3, last_remote_status),
            last_error = $4,
            next_attempt_at = NOW() + ($5::double precision * INTERVAL '1 second'),
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE nonce = $1
          AND status = 'pending'
          AND lease_owner = $2
